scientific_scope: VisDrone fixed1610 confirmation, not RUOD confirmation or training.
cohort: Original full1610, fixed metadata order. Content-only preflight passed, 1610 unique bytes/pixels, no exact-byte overlap with prior roles. Scene independence remains unverified.
model_policy: All19 configurations run in the same cloud environment. Fixed original trained checkpoints, no model, epoch, threshold or seed selection from test-dev results.
measurement: Same F,Q,R object identities, project matching conf .25 IoU .5. Three pre-existing calibration draws, all ordered redraw-null pairs; paired whole-image bootstrap2000. G1 versus three fixed single controls and G1+G5 versus three fixed pair controls. No general random-selection claim from three controls.
tag_audit: Reuse Report93 definitions and frozen estimate() exactly. MSE Q/R XOR, <=8/image by original quality, joint m+d bins .05 with initial R hit/class/size/availability. QAT@10 primary; losses and gains separate, all-state change descriptive. QAT@3/13 secondary, correlated.
sensitivity: Report every preset m-only,d-only,joint+IoU,same-image comparison and prefix-cluster bootstrap. Individual intervals without multiplicity adjustment; do not replace primary with favorable sensitivity.
decision: Positive interval supports a conditional association for this frozen model/cohort; interval crossing zero is inconclusive, not proof of no information. Report effect size, interval and matching coverage, including all negative outcomes. No inference about AP, training benefit or model novelty.
limitation: This first confirmation reuses three fixed draws and three control sets. Expanded20-draw/100-control blueprint, new training seeds, fresh RUOD-R test and actual INT8 are not completed by this bundle.
